entities.summary: Jakub Galvas is a Czech professional ice hockey defenseman who currently plays with the HC Oceláři Třinec of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). Galvas was selected 150th overall by the Blackhawks in the 2017 NHL Entry Draft.
